title: Implement calibration module (judge/utils/calibration.py)
acceptance_criteria: Fritsch-Carlson monotone Hermite spline correctly maps raw model scores to calibrated scores for max_score=5 and max_score=10 using hardcoded anchor points
Strictness presets (Strict/Normal/Lenient) apply a multiplier to the calibrated score: Strict=0.8, Normal=1.0, Lenient=1.2, clamped to [0, max_score]
Module exports a public function: calibrate_score(raw_score, max_score, strictness='Normal') -> float
Module handles edge cases: raw_score=None, max_score=0, invalid strictness, null/negative scores
